_note: Look Closer labels. The page reads names and button text from here, so a label set is a data change. Moonwraith/Zeref wording follows Emeth's character_labels_PROPOSED.json (Cory applies via this file). Caption overrides must keep the honesty phrases checked in look-closer-subjects.mjs. 'characters' is keyed by a lowercase name: when the active beast has that name, the page uses its own button and subtitle. 'displayNames' rewrites a raw creature name for display only.
